result.summary: A narrow urban street with row houses and mixed-use buildings. Pedestrian infrastructure is minimal, consisting of narrow sidewalks with some debris and no marked crossings or traffic calming measures visible.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Debris and trash are scattered on the right-hand sidewalk, creating tripping hazards and narrowing the usable path.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or curb ramps visible at the approaching intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross in unmarked areas.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway with Obstacles
hazards.description: Utility poles are located within the narrow sidewalk area, further restricting the clear width for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection to provide safe and accessible crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Cleaning
interventions.description: Regularly clear debris and repair cracked pavement to ensure a safe, unobstructed walking surface.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a narrow, poorly maintained sidewalk adjacent to residential buildings and a fenced lot. The walkway is cluttered with debris and overgrown vegetation, lacking any buffer from the roadway.

hazards.name: Tripping hazards
hazards.description: Cracked pavement, weeds, and loose debris on the sidewalk surface.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian buffer
hazards.description: No physical separation or buffer zone between the narrow sidewalk and the travel lane.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repave the sidewalk to remove cracks and clear all weeds and debris to ensure a level, unobstructed walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Greening and Buffers
interventions.description: Install small planters or street trees where space permits to create a psychological and physical buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides, though they lack a physical buffer from the roadway. The environment is characterized by a lack of marked pedestrian crossings and traffic calming measures, with some minor obstructions present on the walkway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lane with no physical separation or planting strip to protect pedestrians from vehicles.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Debris and trash are present on the left sidewalk, creating a minor trip hazard and narrowing the usable path.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and utility poles may obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street and along the curb line

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Add a buffer zone with trees and vegetation to separate pedestrians from traffic and provide shade.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility paint to alert drivers to pedestrian presence and define safe crossing points.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a continuous, well-maintained sidewalk along a narrow residential street. The lack of a buffer between the walkway and the roadway, combined with a vacant lot that reduces natural surveillance, are the primary safety concerns.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The parked vehicle on the left obscures sight lines between the sidewalk and the roadway for pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The vacant lot and windowless side wall of the adjacent building reduce natural surveillance and eyes on the street.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving vehicles while improving the streetscape.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Installing dedicated pedestrian lighting would improve safety and visibility during nighttime hours.
